title: Mid-Autumn mooncakes
body:
Families exchange boxes of lotus seed mooncakes at work and at home.

Generation notes: Grandparents insist on homemade; parents buy boxed sets.

title: Mid-Autumn mooncakes
body:
Printed mooncakes ordered from apps, eaten on video calls with relatives abroad.

Generation notes: Young people send digital red envelopes instead.

title: Sunday ferry picnics
body:
Families ride the river ferry and eat on the far bank.

Generation notes: Stopped after the 2034 flood.

title: Flood memorial walk
body:
Each January people walk the old waterline with lanterns.

Generation notes: Children born after 2040 treat it as a festival.
